import ctypes

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototypes
# double gsl_cdf_ugaussian_P(double x);
gsl.gsl_cdf_ugaussian_P.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_ugaussian_P.restype = ctypes.c_double

# double gsl_cdf_ugaussian_Q(double x);
gsl.gsl_cdf_ugaussian_Q.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_ugaussian_Q.restype = ctypes.c_double

# double gsl_cdf_ugaussian_Pinv(double P);
gsl.gsl_cdf_ugaussian_Pinv.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_ugaussian_Pinv.restype = ctypes.c_double

# double gsl_cdf_ugaussian_Qinv(double Q);
gsl.gsl_cdf_ugaussian_Qinv.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_ugaussian_Qinv.restype = ctypes.c_double


def compute_gaussian_cdf_and_inverse(x):
    P = gsl.gsl_cdf_ugaussian_P(x)
    Q = gsl.gsl_cdf_ugaussian_Q(x)
    Pinv = gsl.gsl_cdf_ugaussian_Pinv(P)
    Qinv = gsl.gsl_cdf_ugaussian_Qinv(Q)
    return P, Q, Pinv, Qinv

    # Test case 1
    x = 2.0
    P, Q, Pinv, Qinv = compute_gaussian_cdf_and_inverse(x)
    assert abs(P - 0.9772498680518208) < 1e-9, "Test case 1 failed for P"
    assert abs(Q - 0.02275013194817921) < 1e-9, "Test case 1 failed for Q"
    assert abs(Pinv - x) < 1e-9, "Test case 1 failed for Pinv"
    assert abs(Qinv - x) < 1e-9, "Test case 1 failed for Qinv"

    # Test case 2
    x = 0.0
    P, Q, Pinv, Qinv = compute_gaussian_cdf_and_inverse(x)
    assert abs(P - 0.5) < 1e-9, "Test case 2 failed for P"
    assert abs(Q - 0.5) < 1e-9, "Test case 2 failed for Q"
    assert abs(Pinv - x) < 1e-9, "Test case 2 failed for Pinv"
    assert abs(Qinv - x) < 1e-9, "Test case 2 failed for Qinv"

    # Test case 3
    x = -1.0
    P, Q, Pinv, Qinv = compute_gaussian_cdf_and_inverse(x)
    assert abs(P - 0.15865525393145707) < 1e-9, "Test case 3 failed for P"
    assert abs(Q - 0.8413447460685429) < 1e-9, "Test case 3 failed for Q"
    assert abs(Pinv - x) < 1e-9, "Test case 3 failed for Pinv"
    assert abs(Qinv - x) < 1e-9, "Test case 3 failed for Qinv"

    assert_test()
